content:
Apple is facing ongoing component supply constraints, with MacBook Air inventory rapidly depleting. Below is the latest MacBook Air stock-out situation at Apple's official store and third-party retailers.

MacBook Air Supply Tightens

If you visit Apple's online store today to purchase a MacBook Air, the estimated delivery time for nearly all configurations is two to three weeks from now. Most physical stores indicate that stock for in-store pickup won't be available until the first week of September. This situation applies to both the 13-inch and 15-inch MacBook Air.

Custom-configured MacBook Air models with larger RAM and storage capacity are even more constrained. For example, the 13-inch MacBook Air with 32GB RAM requires over a month for shipping, with in-store pickup potentially delayed until the last week of September.

Bloomberg previously noted the MacBook Air stock-out situation, attributing the cause to ongoing memory supply constraints in the industry. Mark Gurman pointed out that Apple, due to supply tightness, is actively promoting the MacBook Pro to consumers. According to Apple retail staff, the MacBook Air stock situation is "the tightest they can remember."

At Apple's most recent earnings call, CFO Kevan Parekh warned that supply constraints affecting iPhone, iPad, and Mac will further worsen as the quarter progresses.

Where Can You Still Buy a MacBook Air

Apple's official store is certainly not the only avenue for purchasing a MacBook Air. In fact, some Apple authorised retail partners have more stable supply.

On Amazon, a small selection of MacBook Air models are available for immediate delivery, with some configurations priced below Apple's pricing.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: from $1,243 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: from $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: from $1,649 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: from $1,399 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: from $1,689 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: from $1,904 (originally $1,999)

We have no way of knowing exactly how much MacBook Air inventory Amazon has, but we expect they'll soon face the same supply issues as Apple. For now, however, supply remains relatively stable.

Some M5 MacBook Air configurations are also available for immediate shipping through Apple's Certified Refurbished Store.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: $1,359 (originally $1,599 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)
  • …and more configurations available…

Purchases from Apple's Certified Refurbished Store come with a one-year warranty, 14-day return policy, and eligibility to purchase AppleCare.

Conclusion

If you're planning to buy a MacBook Air, I'd recommend getting one as soon as possible. Apple's supply shortage is expected to worsen before it improves. The next-generation MacBook Air won't arrive until at least next year at the earliest, and will only be a minor spec upgrade.

Are you shopping for a new Mac? Has the ongoing supply shortage affected your purchasing plans? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
